# WyDev

WyDev is a mobile-friendly GitHub developer workspace for repository browsing, file editing, code search, changes, commits, pull requests, diagnostics, and deployment handoffs.

## Public pages
- /
- /legal/about.html
- /legal/privacy.html
- /legal/terms.html
- /legal/contact.html

## Product limits
- Free: up to 10 repositories and 3 AI diagnoses per day.
- Pro: $1 USD or ₦1,000 NGN per month, recurring, with higher limits and Pro-only capabilities.
